texts.en:
We need to expand our influence beyond our home £system£ System, and the first step towards doing this is to survey the neighboring star systems.

To do this, select your £science_ship£ Science Ship and click on the Survey button in its fleet interface. Then click on the Open Galaxy Map button at the bottom of the screen, and select one of the stars neighboring our own. The Science Ship will now journey to this star system and survey all bodies within.
